[[Category:Electromagnetism]]
A '''photon''' is the smallest discrete packet of [[electromagnetic radiation]], modelled as a [[fundamental particle]].

== Fundamental properties ==

Since a photon is part of an electromagnetic radiation, it

* is massless ($m=0$)
* has no finite size
* has no substructure
* travels at speed of light $c$
* characterised by its wavelength $\lambda$ or frequency $\nu$, where
